Technical summary / requirements (from call):
- Workloads: doc search for support KB, contextual RAG in chat UI, reranking of KNN candidates (hybrid rerank), embeddings for semantic search.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 latency for retrieval+rerank ~200-300ms, QPS currently small (10-50), bursts up to ~150 qps during product launches.
- Cost sensitivity: small team, wants predictable per-token + per-embedding costs; will start with self-serve credits then commit if SLA/price OK.

- Vector DB questions: evaluating Pinecone vs Weaviate vs Qdrant/Milvus; asked for guidance on hosted vs self-hosted vectors and easiest path with Redwood hosted API.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 is required by customers they integrate with; they also want SSO (SAML) for internal console access, audit logs and ability to set short data retention (30 days) for prod POC.

- Hosted API for prototype: immediate keys, embedding + generation endpoints, sample scripts for indexing to Pinecone and Qdrant.
- Reranking options discussed: (1) Redwood returns candidates + pass-through to a reranker model via hosted generation; (2) use Optimize suggestions for hybrid recall/rerank to reduce token cost.
- Suggested config: batching for embeddings, prefix caching for common queries, and fallback to smaller models for cost control.
